unresolved: The pre-existing 定 さだ.か explanation gap remains unresolved.
The pre-existing 違 ちが.える, -ちが.える, たが.う and たが.える explanation gaps remain unresolved; the app can offer たが.う.

preservedDisagreement: The reviewers both accepted the conservative 勘定/料金 guard but continued to disagree about whether it was necessary.
limits: Emulator and finite sampled evidence only. Physical-phone, handwriting-recognition, native-speaker, global semantic, merged-tree, publication and general-release acceptance are not implied.
